Couples lessons
services.desc: Operation 36 is a structured golf program where beginners learn by playing on the course from day one. Golfers start 25 yards from the green, playing nine holes with a goal of shooting 36 or better. Once achieved, they move back, progressing toward the full tee box. Participants join group coaching, skill-building activities, and track progress through the Operation 36 app. Ready to improve and have more fun? Sign up today! Discounts available for Wildhorse Resort & Casino/CTUIR Employees and CTUIR Tribal Members. All Wildhorse Resort & Casino Season Pass Memberships will have OGA Memberships/Dues attached - $55 per member application ($30 Junior) Ask staff for more details, if needed. Golf
